note: An intermediate agility warm-up (part 3), the author's pattern Do Re Do, Do Mi Do, Do Fa Do, Do Sol Do as a run (RUN_STAGES out-from-do, the first), a semitone higher each pass; also sung on /learn/pitch-matching-exercises.

exercise.title: Agility: out from Do and back
exercise.why: Every note comes straight back to Do, so your ear checks each step against the same home note while your voice learns to move quickly.

cells.text:
Press Play below to hear the run: the mic starts with it. Sing along on the note names: {{1}} {{2}} {{1}}, {{1}} {{3}} {{1}}, {{1}} {{4}} {{1}}, {{1}} {{5}} {{1}}, quick out and a beat back on {{1}}.
Each pass starts a semitone higher. Change to "oo" when the run gets high.
_Don't reach for high notes: let a pass go when its top stops feeling easy._
